description: This file defines the 'FOVKick' class, which manages field-of-view animations such as zoom effects during gameplay, using Unity's Camera component and coroutines to animate FOV changes.

classes.name: FOVKick
classes.description: A class responsible for managing camera field-of-view effects such as zoom in and out, typically during player actions like sprinting.

methods.name: Setup
methods.description: Initializes the FOVKick with a specific camera and records the original field of view.

methods.name: CheckStatus
methods.description: Validates that the camera and increase curve are properly set; throws exceptions if not.

methods.name: ChangeCamera
methods.description: Updates the reference to the camera used by FOVKick.

methods.name: FOVKickUp
methods.description: Coroutine that increases the camera's FOV over time based on the animation curve.

methods.name: FOVKickDown
methods.description: Coroutine that decreases the camera's FOV back to original size over time.
